findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bad_times_how_to_make · Private data: bad_times_photo_tips · Public sink: bad_times_how_to_make · Destructive: bad_times_overview.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bad_times_how_to_make · Private data: bad_times_photo_tips · Public sink: bad_times_how_to_make · Destructive: bad_times_overview

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
